name: simply-events-calendar
description: A simple, responsive events calendar for WordPress. Easily create one-time or recurring events and display them anywhere with shortcodes, Elementor widgets, and one-click Add to Calendar.

scripts.copy:js: echo 'JavaScript files are maintained directly in assets/js/'
scripts.lint:js: echo 'JS Linting: Run manually with a code editor'
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.zip: npm run dist && cd dist && python -c "import zipfile, os; z = zipfile.ZipFile('../simply-events-calendar.zip', 'w'); [z.write(os.path.join(root, file), os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, file), '.')) for root, dirs, files in os.walk('.') for file in files]; z.close()"
